uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-4247-5263.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2201-2558-5687-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

2111-3545-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

3532-3836-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3836-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4772-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2921-4871-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4871-5220-5243.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

725-1329-3661-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Shield Sphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Shield Sphere, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

6529-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2615-3373.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a higher life total than Tree of Perdition's toughness.
2615-3373.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
2615-3373.notes: If the opponent's life total was at least double Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved, they will lose the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

1545-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-5900-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3499-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3334-3484-5391-6291.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3334-3484-5391-6291.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot and a tapped 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Robot and Thopter enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1479-3257-6754.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3705-5231-5997-6556.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

3602-5256--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1479-1671-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-3534.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Field of the Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

38-301-6258.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-6258.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat.

2273-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Slivers on the battlefield.
2273-2440-3263.description:
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for the lowest mana value Sliver creature card in your library and putting it into your hand.
Cast the Sliver by paying its mana cost.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Sliver on the battlefield.
Repeat until you have no Slivers left in your library.
2273-2440-3263.notes: The amount of mana required to execute this combo fluctuates depending on the lowest mana value of Slivers in your library, as well as how many Slivers are on the battlefield as you execute the combo.

318-978-1429-4853.notablePrerequisites:
Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Rakdos Riteknife attached to any artifact creature you control except Lesser Masticore that does not have summoning sickness.
318-978-1429-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Rakdos Riteknife attached by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping the creature with Rakdos Riteknife attached.
Resolve the Lesser Masticore trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the creature's ability from step 1, putting a blood counter on Rakdos Riteknife.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blood counters on Rakdos Riteknife, you may activate its ability by paying {B}{R} and sacrificing it, causing target opponent to sacrifice all permanents they control.

1219-2348-4438-4499-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {3}.
"Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.
1219-2348-4438-4499-4875.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2018-3574-4053.description:
Cast Mikaeus with X=0.
Mikaeus dies due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth returns Mikaeus to the battlefield.
Repeat for step 2 for a mandatory loop that draws the game.

618-1295-4091.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate a token copy of Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite token copy of Aphetto Alchemist, you may cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield ability triggers, causing you to win the game.
